name: combat_idle
prompt: A person stands in a ready fighting stance holding a sword in the right hand, knees slightly bent, breathing calmly.

name: sprint
prompt: A person sprints forward very fast, pumping both arms, leaning forward.

name: slash_1
prompt: A person holding a sword in the right hand steps forward and swings it in a wide horizontal slash from right to left, then returns to a ready stance.

name: slash_2
prompt: A person holding a sword in the right hand swings it in a fast backhand slash from left to right across the body, then returns to a ready stance.

name: slash_3
prompt: A person holding a sword in the right hand spins around once and finishes with a powerful diagonal slash downward, then recovers.

name: heavy_overhead
prompt: A person raises a heavy sword high above the head with both hands and slams it straight down onto the ground in front of them, then straightens up.

name: ledge_hang
prompt: A person hangs from a ledge with both arms stretched straight up above the head, hands gripping, legs dangling loosely below.
note: No take hung: all 4 stood with the arms up. The hang loop is shimmy take 01 (legs dangling).

name: shimmy
prompt: A person hanging from a ledge with both arms above the head moves sideways to the right hand over hand, legs dangling.

name: pull_up
prompt: A person hanging from a ledge with both arms above the head pulls themselves up and climbs over the top onto their feet.

name: climb
prompt: A person climbs up a vertical wall hand over hand, reaching up with alternating arms and stepping up with alternating legs.

name: wall_slide
prompt: A person slides down against a wall with one hand pressed on the wall above the head and the knees bent.

name: front_flip
prompt: A person jumps and does a front flip in the air, tucking the knees to the chest, and lands on their feet.

name: backflip
prompt: A person jumps and does a backflip in the air, tucking the knees, and lands on their feet.

name: side_flip
prompt: A person jumps and does a sideways aerial flip, rolling the body to the side in the air, and lands on their feet.

name: long_jump
prompt: A person runs and dives forward in a long jump, body stretched out horizontally with both arms reaching forward.

name: air_jump
prompt: A person jumps high into the air, tucking the legs up and swinging the arms upward.

name: fall_loop
prompt: A person is falling through the air, arms raised to the sides and legs slightly bent, flailing gently.
note: Rejected: all 4 takes stand with straight legs; the Tripo fall loop stays the air pose.

name: land_hard
prompt: A person lands from a high jump into a deep crouch with one hand touching the ground, then stands back up.

name: slide
prompt: A person slides on the ground feet first, leaning far back with one hand trailing on the floor.

name: skid
prompt: A person running fast stops abruptly, digging the heels in and leaning far back to brake.

name: crouch
prompt: A person crouches down low on bent knees and stays still, looking forward.

name: ground_pound
prompt: A person jumps up and slams down to the ground, landing hard in a deep crouch with both fists hitting the floor, then stands up.

name: roll
prompt: A person does a quick forward roll on the ground and comes back up onto their feet.

name: knockback
prompt: A person is shoved hard in the chest, stumbles backwards two steps with the arms flung forward, then catches their balance.
note: First prompt rejected: all 4 takes raised the sword hand and barely moved. Re-prompted (raw_dir knockback_b).

name: wall_kick
prompt: A person kicks off a wall behind them with one foot and leaps forward through the air, arms swinging forward.
